caption_argument_segments: LinkedIn replaced its algorithm with a single AI system. And it works differently from what you are used to.
Every post now goes through four stages before it reaches anyone. Quality check, testing, distribution, and matching.

1. The first stage filters out spam and engagement bait instantly. 2. The second stage shows your post to a small group and watches what happens. If people engage, distribution expands and if they scroll past, it stops.…

A few numbers worth knowing: Comments now carry 15x more weight than likes. One save drives 5x more reach than a like and 2x more than a comment. Posts with 60+ seconds of dwell time hit 15.6% engagement. Posts with und…
Once you see how it works, you post differently.
